full_judgment:
Sheikh Abdul Awal J: This appeal at the instance of plaintiff-appellant is directed against the judgment and decree dated 15-11-2007 (decree signed on 20-11-2007) passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong in Other Suit No. 16 of 2000 dismissing the suit. 

 5. On consideration of the evidence on record both oral and documentary the learned Joint District Judge by his judgment and decree dated 15-11-2007 dismissed the suit on the finding that there was no breach of contract by the defendant and that the plaintiff was not willing and ready to perform his part of the contract. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree dated 15-11-2007 the plaintiff-appellant has come before this Court and preferred the instant appeal. 

 6. Mr Khijir Ahmed, the learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff-appellant in the course of his argument after placing the plaint of the suit, deposition of witnesses, impugned judgment and decree along with other relevant materials on record including the exhibits submits that the trial Court below having failed to consider that there was a contract in between the plaintiff-appellant and the defendant-respondent No. 1 and part payment of consideration money is admitted and the plaintiff was willing and ready to perform his part and thereby the trial Court below committed illegality in dismissing the suit. He next submits that the finding of the trial Court below to the effect that plaintiff was not in position to pay the entire balance amount is perverse being based on misreading and non-consideration of the materials on record. 

 28. In the result, the appeal is dismissed. The judgment and decree dated 15-11-2007 (decree signed on 20-11-2007) passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong in Other Suit No. 16 of 2000 dismissing the suit is upheld. Since the appeal is dismissed the connected rule being Civil Rule No. 773 (F) of 2007 is discharged.
